caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top, angled slightly upward on both sides. The table is composed of light wood, with two decorative side supports featuring circular cutouts and a curved design at the bottom. There is a visible horizontal support shelf beneath the tabletop, and below this shelf is a single large drawer with stylized, darker wood grain inlays bordered by black outline trim in a geometric pattern. The legs of the table have a faint vertical panel detail, and the front right leg displays an additional black decorative inlay shaped like an elongated “V.” The wood color ranges from pale beige for the frame and tabletop to medium brown for the drawer front and inner shelf, with subtle shading indicating texture. The background is light and unadorned.
title: Pa. German Hutch Table
